properties.name: Galla ipari övezet
properties.method: Literal source-vector circuit extraction from the single-page Tatabánya Városrészek településrendezési szempontú lehatárolása map, annex 3 of municipal regulation 8/2018 (IV.19.). Original decimal PDF path operands and graphics matrices are evaluated exactly, rather than snapping MuPDF float32 endpoint approximations. Every exported edge is an actual selected source line item, possibly reversed. Explicit source subcircuits omit documented out-and-back nonboundary strokes; no buffer, make_valid, invented closing edge, smoothing, clipping or geographical snapping is used. The frozen earlier municipal-outline affine georegistration into EOV/EPSG:23700 is preserved and inverse-projected into WGS84. Historical source overlaps and small differences from the current OSM city boundary remain unmodified and recorded.
properties.sourcePeriod: 2018 municipal map; current legal force and underlying data date not independently checked.

referenceMunicipalityComparison.interpretation: Historical source outline plus approximate registration compared with contemporary OSM reference; mismatch preserved, not repaired.

properties.sourceInterpretation: Individually named literal source circuit, with explicitly recorded nonboundary retraced spur.

excludedNonboundarySourceStrokes.reason: Exact out-and-back spur: vertices 366 and 368 are identical. Both opposite traversals are nonboundary strokes; no replacement edge.

properties.sourceOverlapCaveat: The original source has small boundary overlaps; they are measured separately and preserved without trimming.
properties.license: Municipal map open-reuse license not independently established; ODbL-1.0 pertains to the OSM registration reference.
properties.attribution: Source: Tatabánya 8/2018 (IV.19.), annex 3; geographic registration reference ©OpenStreetMap contributors.
